description: This file sets up the menu options for the Opportunities module in SuiteCRM, including links to create, list, and import opportunities, based on access control permissions.

classes.name: ACLController
classes.description: Provides access control checking methods, specifically checkAccess for module permissions.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the specified permission ('edit', 'list', 'import') for a given module.
